title: fix(lint): warn when a context pack reads an injected column with no storage on an external object
body:
Fixes #37432

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：给外部数据源对象写资料包的作者，在校验和保存时会多看到一条提醒，指出某个平台自动添加的字段（负责人、创建时间等）在外部库里没有存储；解释文本也说明了平台自动添加的字段算作已定义。
- 为什么做：属于资料包（让助手读懂一条记录）专题的收尾，替给外部对象写资料包的作者解决「校验通过但助手读不到」的问题。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是作者多看到一条只提醒、不拦截的警告，保存照常成功，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `validateAiContext` (`packages/lint/src/validate-ai-context.ts`) gains `ai-context-field-unprovisioned`, a `warning`. It fires where a pack names an injected system column of an ADR-0015 `external` object. It covers every place the rule reads a field map: the root's `fields`, `body.field`, and each `related` entry's `fields`, `where`, `orderBy` and link field (named or implied). Each object is judged by its own provenance, through `unprovisionedInjectedColumnsFor` (`system-fields.ts`), the spec derivation every other unprovisioned-anchor rule reads. No second copy of the predicate exists. The message is the shared short clause (`unprovisionedAnchorVerdict`) plus a consequence for the position, and the fix is the shared `unprovisionedAnchorFix`. A column the author declares on the external object is never judged.
- `body.field` on an injected column keeps its `ai-context-body-not-long-text` finding, and the new warning is added beside it. No injected column is long text, so both findings always appear together, and each one states an independent fact.
- `os explain`: a new `ai-context-field-unprovisioned` entry (shared cause paragraph, cost by position, shared remedy). The `ai-context-field-unknown` entry is rewritten to say that injected columns count as defined, that a column the platform does not inject is still unknown, and that the external case belongs to the new id. The new id is exported from `@objectstack/lint` and joins the two anchor-id lists in the `UNPROVISIONED_ANCHOR_*` doc comments.
- `service-record-context`: `injected-system-columns.test.ts` is folded into `record-context-tools.test.ts` as a top-level describe. All three cases are kept, and the separate file is deleted. Per the card's scope note (comment 7182743879), one nested describe pins link resolution on a `sys_*` root, where the child carries injected `sys_user` references: a named `owner_id` or `created_by` is the link and reads its own rows; with no name, the three injected references leave the list out silently; a door serving declared fields alone has no link.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-ai-context.test.ts`: a new describe with 7 cases. The warning appears at all five paths on an external root and child. The same pack on non-external objects is clean. An external child under a local root is judged per object. An author-declared column is not judged. `body.field` gets both findings. A related list linked through an external child's injected `owner_id` is reported. The explain entry is checked for its named facts. There is also an explain check for `ai-context-field-unknown`, and the new id joins the "every emitted id has an explain entry" list.
- `packages/services/service-record-context/src/__tests__/record-context-tools.test.ts`: the folded describe (3 original cases plus 4 link cases).

## Acceptance notes

- First read, by risk: (1) `validate-ai-context.ts`, the link hunk (the `link` resolution rewritten from an early `return` into a value, the only reshaped control flow); (2) the same file, the body hunk (two findings on one path); (3) `rule-explanations.ts`, the two ai-context entries.
- Not changed, fenced out of this card: `skills/objectstack-ai/references/context-packs.md` has a table of the ai-context rule ids. No gate reads that table, and it does not list the new id. Carrier: the area seat.
- The `where` / `orderBy` / link consequences in the messages ("no rows", "an arbitrary order") repeat the siblings' measured readings (`page-field-unprovisioned`, `sort-field-unprovisioned`). They were not measured again for `get_record_context` over a remote table.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-ai-context.test.ts`. Expected: 30 tests pass, including the describe "an injected column with no storage on an external object (ADR-0015)".

<details><summary>Local runs at 30b09f6711</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` and `vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 239 passed (239), Tests 9707 passed | 5 skipped (9712); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-record-context test` and `typecheck`: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 178 passed (178); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one, on the provenance call)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `(anchors = unprovisionedInjectedColumnsFor(objects.get(object)))` with `(anchors = new Set...)`. The anchor count went from 1 to 0 and the blob from 67957ee3b5f5 to 7fa2a74d5075. Then `vitest run src/validate-ai-context.test.ts` gave Tests 4 failed | 26 passed (30). The four red cases were the external-root warning, the per-object case, the body case and the link case, and the non-external clean case stayed green. After restore the blob equals HEAD (67957ee3b5f5) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports the source by a relative path, so no dist rebuild was needed.

</details>
